notes: Entirely business-type hospital; GAAP; governmental fields null. Receipts/disbursements from Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p4): receipts = operating revenues 31,026,076 + nonoperating tax, noncapital grants, interest income; interest expense (480,905) taken as a disbursement; no single total printed so totals computed. Provision for bad debts kept as negative receipts line. Capital grants and contributions 243,575 in business_type.other_financing. Beginning net position uses restated 26,077,101. Foundation component unit statements (pp3, 5) excluded. Schedule 2 salaries and supplies columns recorded as separate detail lines; combined columns tie to 31,185,607. Schedule 3 operating statistics ignored. Cash flow statement continuation (p7, gained in the v8 re-trim) holds only the operating income reconciliation and supplemental disclosure; nothing new recorded (proprietary totals are from p6). Page numbers are trimmed-PDF pages. Read pages 1-11 of 11
